Description:
Add a touch of natural elegance to your space with this striking cut geode. Featuring a polished face that reveals stunning crystal formations and unique banding, this piece dazzles with a blend of gray, white, and earthy tones. The irregular geometric slice contrasts beautifully with its rugged back and edges, making it an eye-catching decorative object for shelves, desks, or bookcases. Crafted from genuine geode, the stone's polished surface highlights captivating natural patterns while the rough back delivers rustic charm. Its sturdy flat bottom allows for easy upright display, letting light play across the crystalline interior for a beautiful effect. Perfect for collectors, enthusiasts, or anyone looking to bring natural artistry into their decor. This geode shows minor edge roughness yet remains clean and visually impressive. Display as a standalone piece or pair with other minerals for a curated look
